verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management SaaS. Its AI Teammates handle coordination work inside Asana. Having an agent verify its own code implementation by navigating an app and capturing before-and-after screenshots is a coding-agent or browser-testing axis, outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Asana shipping any app-navigation or screenshot-verification capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
